description:
Job Title: PowerApp/SharePoint Developer 
 
Job Category: Information Technology 
 
Time Type: Full time 
 
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: Secret 
 
Employee Type: Regular 
 
Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10% 
 
Type of Travel: Local 
 
 
* * * 
 
 The Opportunity: 
 CACI is seeking a software development professional to join our team supporting a Department of Defense (DoD) client. If you are looking for your next career challenge, CACI would like to speak with you.  In this role, you will be a valued member of skilled development team, providing web application solutions to support our customer's mission. 
  
 Responsibilities: 
 Design, develop, and maintain solutions that integrate seamlessly with SharePoint Online and other Microsoft 365 services
 Develop and maintain Power Applications
 Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members.
 Create and customize SharePoint sites, lists, and libraries to meet business needs.
 Collaborate with customers, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into technical speciﬁcations
 Produce high-quality code with proper documentation, testing, and adherence to best practices
 Develop and maintain technical documentation for applications and processes; document accessibility features to promote transparency and facilitate future improvements
 Ensure compliance with organizational security standards and best practices
 Optimize application performance and troubleshoot issues
 Ensure all developed applications and interfaces comply with Section 508 standards and Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG).
 Support regular accessibility audits to identify and address compliance issues. Implement necessary changes to maintain compliance and continuously improve accessibility features.
  
 Qualifications: 
 Required: 
 Active DoD Secret Clearance (or higher)
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical ﬁeld (or work equivalent)
 3-6 years of experience in a software/application development role
 Experience in developing User Interfaces to applications using html, JavaScript and CSS
 Experience with SharePoint Online and Power Platform along with Azure DevOps (Git)
 DoD Manual 8140.03 level Intermediate from the Foundational Qualiﬁcation Options for the Software Developer work role including applicable certiﬁcation(s) (e.g. CSSLP) or be able to obtain within 6 months of starting position
 Knowledge of WCAG v2.0
 Ability to obtain DHS Section 508 Trusted Tester Certification within 6 months of start date
  
 Desired: 
 Relevant certiﬁcations in SharePoint, Power Apps, or web development technologies could be considered as supplementary qualiﬁcations Experience working within the DoD
 DHS Section 508 Trusted Tester Certiﬁcation
 Knowledge of DoD guidelines, organizational policies, and industry best practices
 Experience with Agile development methodologies (e.g. SCRUM)
 Knowledge of UI/UX best practices
 
 
This position is contingent on funding and may not be filled immediately. However, this position is representative of positions within CACI that are consistently available. Individuals who apply may also be considered for other positions at CACI. 
 
 What You Can Expect: 
  A culture of integrity. 
 At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.
 An environment of trust. 
 CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
 A focus on continuous growth. 
 Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.
 
 

 Pay Range : 
 There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.
 
 The proposed salary range for this position is: 
$72,700 - $149,200 
 
 
 
 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
